scenario.title: The Unexpected Venue Change
scenario.description: Brad and Melissa, two event planners for a community charity gala, meet at a local park to discuss the final preparations. It's a sunny, warm afternoon and children can be heard playing in the background. Suddenly, Brad gets a call from the venue manager who informs him that due to unforeseen circumstances, the venue booked for the gala is unavailable. They have to find a new venue within 24 hours.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Brad is composed, strategic, and pragmatic when it comes to problem-solving. He believes in maintaining a positive attitude and tackling challenges head-on.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Melissa is flexible and solution-focused. She is calm under pressure and can quickly adapt to unexpected changes, showing resilience and resourcefulness.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Melissa is rigid and struggles to cope with unexpected changes. She tends to panic and becomes overwhelmed easily, focusing more on the problem than a solution.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Melissa is reactive and blames others when things go wrong. She tends to take out her frustration on those around her, often losing her temper and acting impulsively.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Melissa, we have a problem. The venue manager just called and said our booked venue is no longer available.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Oh wow, that's quite a curveball. When do we need to have a new place by?

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: We have 24 hours to secure a new venue. Any ideas?

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Let's not panic, we've dealt with worse. I'll call some of our contacts now, and we can start scouting potential places immediately.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: You're right, we've definitely conquered bigger challenges. I'll start looking into some back-up venues.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Great, let's meet back here in 2 hours with our options. And hey, we've got this!
